title: GTA V Made a Billion Dollars in Three Days
hook: GTA 5 pulled in $800 million on day one and passed $1 billion in three days, a record Guinness confirmed. With GTA 6 preloading now and landing Thursday, does it beat that?
script: Did you know Grand Theft Auto Five hit one billion dollars in sales in just three days? The game launched on September seventeenth, 2013, for PlayStation Three and Xbox 360. Take-Two announced that it sold more than eight hundred million dollars worth of copies on its first day alone. That was the biggest launch day the company had ever seen. Two days later the total passed one billion dollars. Take-Two said it believed no entertainment property, including any video game or feature film, had ever reached that number so fast. Guinness World Records agreed, and in October 2013 it confirmed seven records for the game. Those included the fastest entertainment property to gross a billion dollars and the fastest video game to do it. Remember, at the time you could only buy it on PlayStation Three and Xbox 360. Thirteen years later, the sequel is finally about to arrive. Preloads for Grand Theft Auto Six opened this week, and the game launches on Thursday, November nineteenth. Fans have waited thirteen years for it. Do you think GTA Six breaks that billion dollar record? Follow for more gaming history.
